
	<h1 class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/dnboy/p/19722355" title="发布于 2026-03-15 23:03">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">QClaw内测体验，能用微信指挥AI干活了</span>
    

</a>

	</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>终于拿到腾讯QClaw的内测码，小卷今天就来带大家体验下腾讯的QClaw有哪些能力</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="1腾讯qclaw是什么">1.腾讯QClaw是什么？</h2>
<p>简单总结：<em>腾讯版的OpenClaw，可以在自己电脑本地运行，能操作电脑干活</em></p>
<p>目前处于内测阶段，只有少数拿到邀请码的友友可以玩到</p>
<p>官方地址：<a href="https://qclaw.qq.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://qclaw.qq.com/</a></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e5de51f16206434ab7fc85e3fe8012f9~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=RBW9kHh9LpLs4Duj38CFwM1yqiw%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="2下载安装">2.下载安装</h2>
<p>通过上面的官方地址我们下载QClaw，这里小卷用的macOS版本，你们拿到邀请码下载时按照自己电脑版本下就行，正常下载安装，打开后界面如下：</p>
<p>我们点击<code>关联微信</code>，扫码绑定自己的微信</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/90205e95b04449799d82cc2678b8848d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=CUnGmpcKR03Jc2CBgNd8Jl%2Fb0aM%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/85320330d7024d91924eda770dfe0497~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=eDNA46GmvKseRXBA1op54IyqLSc%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="3关联微信发消息">3.关联微信发消息</h2>
<p>关联后，我们就能在手机上通过客服消息和QClaw沟通了，也能下达命令干活了</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a531aec9a6924a55a3966dc7ab5a806e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=TXmSD6CvjMAM3161x0GEQRZ9YZo%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="4选择大模型">4.选择大模型</h2>
<p>这里小卷看了下，只能用默认大模型和国内的大模型 API，没有支持Coding Plan，预计后续正式版应该会支持，所以就用默认大模型测试了</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/de8ff65c53894ffd9fd7b885680efedf~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=2ZMyP%2BsfltOPSfZB07XWjsS%2BhYY%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="5安装skill">5.安装skill</h2>
<p>咱就不对基础功能进行测试了，我们就看看它是不是真的能干活啊，首先安装一些常用的skill（网络搜索、文件处理等等），直接和QClaw对话就可以安装了</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ff47f1a22b854483ba7de4be55c2ad89~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=eOxxLhk0RfzSSXjcQDTRWtSfNDU%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="6本地测试文件处理">6.本地测试：文件处理</h2>
<p>现在测试QClaw的文件处理能力，比如我想对2025年发布的所有博客进行分析总结，对话内容如下</p>
<blockquote>
<p>帮我总结分析下2025年的博客发布情况，所有博客以markdown格式存在路径：/test</p>
</blockquote>
<p>看下来发现它总结的非常到位，文件处理能力可以满足需要</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a3d887d547814158a6c5713fd9383d3a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=jPiv5eDv9qLtfhTpKq8gyz06nCU%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>接着试试手机端对话，回复情况如下，</p>
<p>其实在电脑端的QClaw可以看到执行过程，QClaw在电脑端回复后，又会把消息再发到微信上。这样咱只要开着电脑，就能通过微信远程指挥QClaw干活了</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/83936618dfdb4c2db33dd39cde0d0eb4~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=m3Sr5luPc0fTqvsggZ1%2BqQURVc4%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="7网络测试搜索信息">7.网络测试：搜索信息</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>检索OPenclaw的最新资讯，给我汇总下</p>
</blockquote>
<p>测试下来执行的速度还比较快，不到一分钟就给我搜索汇总结果了</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/022ab0d717534dadb28cf19be64928a9~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=yLN7cdYHkJPpX%2BHopQWsPksnueU%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="8测试定时任务">8.测试定时任务</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>创建一个定时任务，在3分钟后发微信消息提醒我，定时任务只执行一次，完成后删除掉</p>
</blockquote>
<p>测试下来，定时任务的功能不行，也可能是我没调试好，OpenClaw也有这问题，看后面有没有解决办法吧</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p0-xtjj-private.juejin.cn/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ab35354d479840c884bec94035d86bb7~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Y2356aP5ZCM5a2m:q75.awebp?policy=eyJ2bSI6MywidWlkIjoiMzQ1NjUyMDI5MTA5ODY4NiJ9&amp;rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-orig-authkey=f32326d3454f2ac7e96d3d06cdbb035152127018&amp;x-orig-expires=1774191561&amp;x-orig-sign=Pk3kBR8syqAzPrO8tgVsgUr8ASo%3D" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<p>今天只测试了QClaw一些简单的操作，后续会再做些深度测评，上次说想给大家看看怎么打通公众号发布流程的，其实操作也比较简单，留着下篇文章一并测评了</p>
